annotations.title: URL list checker: syntax, host and port problems before you fetch

description: Check a list of URLs for syntax problems before a crawler, sitemap or link checker uses them: missing scheme, non-numeric port, embedded space, uppercase host. Reports one entry per line with its issues. Choose this when you have a list of URLs and want the syntax problems listed per line — missing scheme, a non-numeric port, an embedded space or a mixed-case host — before a crawler or link checker consumes them. Do not choose this when you need to know whether a URL is reachable: the service makes no network request and cannot report liveness. Example requests: Check this list of URLs for typos before I run the crawler. | Which of these URLs are malformed and why? | Sanity-check my sitemap URLs before I submit them.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

content.description: The customer's urls.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one URL per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

inputs.title: URL list checker: syntax, host and port problems before you fetch

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_url_health_matrix

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.
